note: Two campgrounds about 1.7 km apart. The Mississippi River Campground is a grassy loop below the bluffs, set back from the river behind an active railroad and the boat-ramp lot; Lake Boutin Campground's basic sites line wooded ridge roads south of Lake Boutin. --Claude
summary: MO 2026/2027 sheets: basic $15 (Lake Boutin only, May-Oct), electric 30A $27/$23, FHU 30A $32/$26; 52 bookable sites (Mississippi River 17, Lake Boutin 35) 27-102 ft, 30A max. Waterfront DOWN riverfront -> riverview (pads 80-110 m back behind the railroad and boat-ramp lot). Pin ~500 m off (showerhouse). Lake Boutin a split candidate (~1.7 km). Season left (manual).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN: riverfront -> riverview. The Mississippi River Campground's map and leaf-off imagery put its 17 pads on a grassy loop WEST of the railroad ('The railroad near the Mississippi River Campground is still active' - park camping page); the boat-launch parking lot sits between the tracks and the river. The nearest pads are ~80-110 m from the water's edge (imagery measure; Overpass was down). Open lawn, the tracks and the open paved lot lie between, so a sightline to the river from the north end of the loop is plausible (riverview), but the railroad and day-use lot rule out on-water. apply.py does not write waterfront - set by hand, and rewrite waterfront_evidence.

SPLIT CANDIDATE (not split): Lake Boutin Campground (basic only, May 1-Oct 31; ridge roads around a junction at ~37.4529,-89.4824, south of Lake Boutin) is ~1.7 km west of the Mississippi River Campground (~37.4545,-89.4635), measured on imagery between the two site centres. Entrances: Lake Boutin is reached by the park road past Lake Boutin and the visitor center (its map's 'To Lake Boutin / To Visitor Center'); the Mississippi River Campground has its own road down to the river (its map's 'To Highway 177, restroom, showerhouse'). Both inside one park off Route 177. Lake Boutin's sites are in woods ~100 m+ from the lake (not waterfront).
Pin: 37.4516,-89.4592 sits on the showerhouse clearing ~500 m SE of the Mississippi River Campground loop; suggest 37.4545,-89.4635 (loop centre).
Phone: entry has none; the park page gives Park Office 573-290-5284 (Visitor Center 573-290-5268). apply.py does not write phone.
